subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should the A2UI dashboard bridge be pursued as bundled dashboard work after the browser Canvas action-ingress contract lands, or should this capability move to a plugin/ClawHub path instead?
rationale: The request spans product direction and a security boundary: it depends on the unmerged dashboard custom-widget host and would let sandboxed/browser A2UI content route actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the bridge design to build on the approved browser Canvas action-ingress contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497.

options.title: Move Outward To Plugin/ClawHub
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not a core direction, retain only missing generic APIs in OpenClaw and ask the integration to ship externally.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Bridge
options.body: Pause the bridge until the dashboard custom-widget host itself has a maintainer-approved landing path.

recommendation.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the bridge design to build on the approved browser Canvas action-ingress contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main routing signal for both the Canvas plugin surface and the bundled Control UI plugin-tab precedent.
